exposure: Evaluation in a postpartum pelvic floor healing clinic (PPFHC)
Referral to pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT)
outcome: Attendance to pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT)
cohort: The study included 464 postpartum women at high-risk of pelvic floor concerns from an academic hospital, comprising a group evaluated in a postpartum pelvic floor healing clinic and a historical cohort with third/fourth-degree obstetrical lacerations.
finding: Patients attending postpartum PFPT demonstrated high therapy completion rates and improved symptom scores, but a dedicated PPFHC, while increasing referrals, showed lower PFPT attendance rates compared to a historical cohort.
mod_finding: The postpartum pelvic floor healing clinic (PPFHC) cohort specifically comprised postpartum vaginal delivery patients.
